name: Memento Mortem
location: Given to the investigator as the core supernatural investigation tool.
acquisition_hint: Use it near corpses or remains to access a frozen moment of death.
uses: Replay audio before death and inspect the frozen death scene.

name: Logbook
acquisition_hint: Use it after every memory to record identities, fates, and locations.
uses: Tracks crew roster, sketches, deck plans, and fate entries.

name: Crew Sketch
acquisition_hint: Cross-reference faces with scenes, uniforms, jobs, accents, and relationships.
uses: Helps identify people by face and context.
